'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello. Things have been going very well between us. That is why I would like to involve you in one... complicated task. My men attempted to pass through the Factory, but they were not allowed through. They all died. Now I must fill out a great deal of paperwork and request reinforcements... And we must also punish those responsible. I do not know exactly who was responsible for the deaths of my men, so engage everyone you encounter. And make your shots count, headshots only. I want the enemy to understand that this was not a coincidence.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 15 targets with headshots while using an AUG on [[Factory]]
